greeting: All aboard! The sky-train waits for no one!
Trackmaster Tiberius, at your service! Punctuality is my passion!
Tickets, please! Just kidding! I don't check tickets!
Welcome to the Aether Express! Destination: everywhere!
The train departs precisely on time! Early, actually! I'm that good!
Need passage? The rails in the sky are always open!
Step aboard! Mind the gap! It's a LONG way down!
dialog.schedule_inquiry: Next departure: always! The Aether Express never stops! Well, it stops at stops. But metaphorically? Never stopping!
dialog.route_explanation: We traverse the Celestial Rails! Floating tracks held up by... honestly, I'm not sure! Ancient magic! Don't question it!
dialog.ticket_purchase: One-way or round-trip? We also offer the unlimited pass! For the truly adventurous!
haggle: Fares are set by the Celestial Rail Authority! Non-negotiable!
I could... lose some paperwork? Ten percent off!
For a charming passenger? I'll waive the luggage fee!
Student discount? You don't look like a student! But okay!
purchase_success: Welcome aboard! The dining car serves actual food!
Your compartment is ready! Watch your head!
purchase_fail: No ticket, no train! Rules are rules!
The rails require maintenance! That costs money!
Perhaps walking suits your budget better?
rumor: The Remnant Vault causes interference with our signals. Trains go quiet near it.
The twins predicted a 'derailment of fate.' I check my bolts twice now!
They say the sunandmoon knows where every train is at all times. Creepy!
Red aeronaut once tried to race the train. He lost! Badly!
The trenchcoat passenger never shows their ticket. I let them ride anyway. Intimidated!
dialog.quest_hook: A section of Celestial Rail has gone dark! Near the Remnant Vault! I need someone to investigate! The trains MUST run on time!
dialog.quest_active: Any news on the dark rail section? My schedule is in shambles!
dialog.quest_complete: Repaired! Brilliant! The rails sing again! Here - take this Rail-Pass. Unlimited rides! Lifetime!
dialog.quest_reward: Lifetime Rail Pass - Free sky-train travel forever!
farewell: Mind the gap! Enjoy the journey!
All aboard! ...When you're ready! No rush!
Safe travels on the celestial rails!
ambient_barks: Next stop: ADVENTURE! Or the next station!
dialog.time_dawn: Morning express! The sunrise special! Beautiful views!
dialog.time_night: The night rail! Sleepers only! Quiet car mandatory!

party_reactions.nix7: Where does this one go? Processing... destination unclear.
party_reactions.twist: CHOO CHOO! ...Is that right? CHOO CHOO!
party_reactions.korr: A noble profession. Keeping schedules is honorable work.
party_reactions.renna: Floating tracks? I'd like to see the engineering schematics.
party_reactions.suresh: The journey matters more than the destination. But punctuality helps.
party_reactions.sova: Reliable transport? That's rare. I respect it.
party_reactions.grit: I've seen the rail mechanism. Don't ask questions. Just ride.
party_reactions.ashka: Does the train ever go faster? Like, MUCH faster?
party_reactions.senna: Ever smuggle anything interesting? On your train?
party_reactions.callum: So organized! So efficient! I love it!
party_reactions.petra: Solid. Dependable. Like a good foundation.

relationship_dialog.stranger: First time on the sky-train? Hold on tight!
relationship_dialog.acquaintance: Back again! Becoming a regular commuter!
relationship_dialog.friend: My favorite passenger! I've saved you the window seat!
relationship_dialog.best_friend: You! Family, practically! Ride free! Always!

mini_quest.title: The Silent Rails
mini_quest.description: Investigate the dark section of Celestial Rail near Remnant Vault

stages.hook: A rail section has gone DARK! Near the Vault! I need answers!
stages.active: Check the third junction past the eastern platform. Bring light!
stages.complete: The rails sing again! My schedule is saved! Lifetime pass! Yours!
